The Next Chapter

Your life is allowed to change direction.

$12.99 USD · planned launch price

A life-planning toolkit in development for the in-between moments: a fresh start, a change of priorities or the feeling that something needs to shift. Start with where you are, define what matters and test your next direction in manageable steps.

Interior previews will be added when the product is ready.

This planner is in development. The complete 90-day workbook is not yet available.

THOUGHTFULLY PUT TOGETHER

What's inside.

  • Planned life-area review: energy, time, relationships, work and wellbeing
  • Planned values and priorities exercises to clarify what to protect or change
  • Planned decision pages for comparing options and naming trade-offs
  • Planned 90-day focus with milestones and weekly next actions
  • Planned stop/start/continue reviews and a reset when circumstances change
A SIMPLE WAY FORWARD
01

Take stock

Notice what gives you energy, what drains it and what no longer fits.

02

Choose a direction

Define one meaningful focus and the trade-offs you are willing to make.

03

Build the next 90 days

Turn that direction into small experiments, milestones and weekly reviews.
